column1: # keys.tsv -- the curated key table for the docs hub (SUPER+SHIFT+/).
#   An ordered, human-curated shortlist of the shortcuts worth showing a newcomer,
#   grouped into sections. It is a list of WHICH keys to show and in WHAT ORDER.
#   It deliberately does NOT contain the descriptions.
#   The description for every key is read live out of config.conf at display time
#   (the comment line directly above that bind -- the same comment the SUPER+/
#   cheatsheet uses). One source of truth. Edit the comment in config.conf and
#   this hub changes with it; there is no second copy here to drift out of date.
#   If a key listed here no longer exists in config.conf, the hub prints it as
#   MISSING rather than silently dropping it -- that is the point of the check.
#   Key rows:         MODS, key          (must match a real bind in config.conf)
#   Display override: MODS, key <TAB> Label to show instead of the raw key
#     (used only for collapsed ranges like the workspace 1-9 rows)
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Matching is on the normalised (mods, key) pair -- whitespace and case of the
# modifier list are ignored, so "SUPER+SHIFT , 1" here matches "SUPER+SHIFT, 1"
# in config.conf. The key name itself is case-sensitive, because mango treats
